Academic DocumentsSecondary school diploma Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent), duly legalised or apostilled (unless not required: contact us via InformaStudenti if you have doubts) Official translation of both documents into Italian (not required if the originals are in English, French, German, or Spanish) B. Recognition documents You must provide one of the following: Certificates issued by ENIC‑NARIC centres, such as CIMEA , containing information on the foreign qualification useful for determining its level, nature and value within the awarding education systemOR Dichiarazione di valore in loco (DoV – Declaration of Value) issued by the Italian Embassy in the country where you obtained your qualification 👉 If you do not yet have these documents, we strongly recommend applying for them as soon as possible, as issuing times may be long. For qualifications obtained in countries that signed the Lisbon Recognition Convention , both the DoV and the Certificates issued by ENIC‑NARIC centres can be replaced by: a Diploma Supplement OR a Statement of Correspondence downloadable from ARDI IMPORTANT: the University reserves the right to request additional documentation, if necessary. C. Documents to submit once you arrive in Italy: Italian tax code (codice fiscale): mandatory for all students Italian Study Visa (only for non-EU students residing abroad) Receipt of your Italian residence permit application, or a valid residence permit card: only for non-EU students Deadlines 31 July 2026 – Deadline for non EU students to complete Universitaly pre enrolment 30 November 2026 – Final deadline to submit all required documents. Enrolment will be cancelled after this date unless delays are justified by documented reasons. For clarifications, please contact us via InformaStudenti , category “International”. We look forward to welcoming you to our academic community. Select your category EU or EU-equivalent with foreign qualification Choose this category if: you are a citizen of a European Union (EU) member state, Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Switzerland, or San Marino; you are a non-EU citizen with a valid Italian residence card (or residence permit application receipt); you have dual citizenship, including one from a EU country non-EU residing abroad with foreign qualification (visa app) Choose this category if you are not a citizen of a European Union (EU) member state, you reside abroad, and you will apply for an Italian student visa Marco Polo Choose this category if you have a Chinese citizenship and you are part of the Marco Polo programme Why do we ask this? Certain steps in the application process, such as applicable deadlines, application form questions or other tasks may depend on the category you choose here.
